# Astral Wish Lab

> Unofficial fan-made wish/pull simulator for gacha-style games: multi-banner wish simulator, pity calculator, primogem planner, and local pull statistics. Includes original example characters, never connects to any game account.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://genshinwishsimulator.app/): Wish simulator and tools
- [Pity System Math](https://genshinwishsimulator.app/guides/pity-system/): Exact soft pity, hard pity and 50/50 probabilities
- [Primogem Planning](https://genshinwishsimulator.app/guides/primogem-planning/): Primogem income per patch for F2P, Welkin and BP players
